phrases.english: Tonight I’m seeing my friend for dinner.
phrases.persian: امشب دوستم رو برای شام می‌بینم.

phrases.english: Maybe I’ll have ice cream too.
I’ve known him/her for nearly a year.

phrases.farsi: Az tarigh-e bâbâ bâhâsh âshenâ shodam.
phrases.persian: از طریق بابا باهاش آشنا شدم.

phrases.english: These days I’m mostly busy with work.
I do yoga once a week.

phrases.farsi: Tanhâ miram. Injuri bishtar dust dâram.
phrases.english: I go on my own. I prefer it this way.
phrases.persian: تنها می‌رم. این‌جوری بیشتر دوست دارم.
